verdict.rationale: Mercury is a banking platform that ships a web app, an official CLI, an MCP server and SDKs. Any of these could plausibly collect telemetry and offer an opt-out, so the privacy-posture axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking or any opt-out control. The dashboard access revocation in the security docs concerns credential access, not telemetry, so it is not credited.
